name: Ginnami Ritsu
source:
"I told you, I'm gonna make you happy. I'm going to make you happy! What's your problem?"

He has a pretty and fragile appearance, but actually, he is a very dry talker. On the other hand, he is the most compassionate keyboardist among the members. He lost all of his family except his elder brother in the "Case in Point" incident, and his brother also joined "Rindou" after his heart was broken.

He is a young man fighting against loneliness, caught between his love for music and his hatred for it.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/ginnami_ritsu.html]official website[/url]]
